PROFISCO Santa Catarina - State Administration Management Modernization Program

description.narrative: Consolidar el proceso de modernizacin de la gestin fiscal a travs de acciones que promuevan: (i) la excelencia del modelo gerencial; (ii) las modernas tecnologas de planificacin; y (iii) la calidad de los servicios pblicos, apoyado por modernas herramientas de tecnologa de la informacin.

To consolidate the fiscal management modernization process through activities directed to: (i) improve the managerial model; (ii) modernize the planning process; (iii) strengthen the public services, supported by modern information and technology tools and instruments.
